act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 19.5.1(c): the Insurer's claims item has no operative words
en.summary: COB 19.5.1(c) reads only "(including by terminating or avoiding a policy); and": there is no verb and no object. The parallel lists for Insurance Intermediaries (COB 11.7.6(c)) and Insurance Managers (COB 20.4.1(c)) read "not unreasonably reject a claim (including by terminating or avoiding a policy); and". Both the amending instrument and the consolidated text show the item with nothing before the parenthesis; it is already incomplete in Amendments No. 2 (2 December 2018), which inserted COB 19. The general claims-handling duty in 19.5.1(a) still applies.
en.correction: Please confirm whether COB 19.5.1(c) should read, as COB 11.7.6(c) and 20.4.1(c) do, "not unreasonably reject a claim (including by terminating or avoiding a policy); and", and amend the rule. Restoring the words adds a duty, so it needs an amending instrument rather than an editorial correction.
